name: Loaf-Pan Roasted Chicken
desc: Marinated chicken thighs packed into a loaf pan, roasted, then flipped out and sliced thin like doner for meal prep.

source.title: Loaf-Pan Roasted Chicken
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, excess fat trimmed
1 medium yellow onion, processed in a food processor
1 tbsp urfa or Aleppo pepper (or other mild chili flakes)

steps: Put the chicken in a large bowl. Add the processed onion, lemon juice, tomato paste and yogurt.
Season with salt, pepper, thyme, garlic powder and urfa or Aleppo pepper, and mix very well to coat.
Cover and marinate in the fridge 2-6 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 425°F and let the chicken sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Pack the chicken tightly into an 8.5 x 4.5 inch loaf pan. Roast 50 minutes, until the center reads 165°F.
Carefully tilt the pan and pour the juices into a heatproof container. Pour them back over the chicken, then drain again.
Flip the loaf out onto a cutting board and slice into thin strips like doner. Serve over rice, in wraps or in bowls.
tips: Grated onion, yogurt and tomato paste all tenderize the chicken.
The creator's newer written version uses 3 tbsp tomato paste and 1.5 tbsp each of thyme and garlic powder; the reel amounts are kept here.
Save the drained juices for pouring over the sliced chicken or for soup. Keeps 4-5 days.

references.title: Loaf Pan Chicken
references.usedFor: pan size, 425°F for 50 min, pouring off juices, 5 servings, newer amounts noted in tips
